title: Comment claims bare-directory `node --test` fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND on Node 22 — contradicts Node 22's documented directory scanning; reads as misdiagnosis
evidence:
+// `node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js` (wired into `make test` as test-js;
+// the bare directory form fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND on the repo's Node 22).
detail: Node 22's test runner accepts directory arguments and scans them for *.test.js files; MODULE_NOT_FOUND is the signature of `node <dir>` without --test (or a missing path). The justification is committed as fact in two files with no reproducer, and the Makefile wiring it references isn't shown.
recommended_fix: Verify the actual failing invocation; either correct the comment to the real cause or drop the parenthetical and keep just the glob command.
